usage: Common everyday word for a tree; very neutral and widely used in spoken Cantonese.
Use it for trees in parks, streets, gardens, forests, and nature contexts.
Often appears with classifiers like 一棵樹 when counting a single tree.
Can also be part of compound words and place descriptions related to plants and landscaping.
